sessions.summary: V2 enrichment Kibana investigation and root cause analysis
accomplishments: Investigated three callIDs for V2 enrichment failures using Kibana
Identified SubstituteSource bug in EnrichmentBindingsRepository.cs:164 — overwrites valueProvider.source object with bare string instead of preserving {type, path} structure
Root cause traced to CdpExtensionService runtime validation failure at enrichment execution time
Documented findings in concept notes and board
